"""Read-only candidate-ID feasibility evidence; no observed code is executed."""
import ast
import hashlib
import json
import sys
import types
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from pathlib import Path

main = Path('/home/linhao/Toolchain/development/LogAnalysisSkill')
sys.path.insert(0,str(main/'docs/clang-fix-campaign/tools'))
from terminal_scan import fixed_inputs, contexts, ModuleIndex, write_atomic
from terminal_alias_preflight import Unit

manifest, files = fixed_inputs(Path.cwd(),main)
index = ModuleIndex(files,contexts(files))
out = main/'docs/clang-fix-campaign/dev_memory/stage14_p49_terminal_batch/a0-evidence/part3/scan07-resume'
rows=[]
groups=defaultdict(list)
for entry in manifest['entries']:
    if entry['entry_kind'] != 'PY_SOURCE':
        continue
    path=entry['path']
    identities=index.by_path.get(path,[])
    module=identities[0][1] if len(identities)==1 else ''
    unit=Unit(files[path].decode(),path,entry['context'],module,Path(path).name=='__init__.py')
    # compile only obtains Python's own lexical names; none of this code runs.
    codes=defaultdict(list)
    def collect(code):
        if code.co_name=='<lambda>':
            codes[code.co_firstlineno].append(code.co_qualname)
        for value in code.co_consts:
            if isinstance(value,types.CodeType):
                collect(value)
    collect(compile(unit.tree,path,'exec',dont_inherit=True))
    for node in ast.walk(unit.tree):
        if not isinstance(node,ast.Lambda):
            continue
        direct_call=isinstance(node.body,ast.Call)
        names=sorted(unit.bindings.resolve(node.body.func)) if direct_call else []
        origin=[]
        # Retain exact lexical import facts, without admitting the callable.
        for imp in ast.walk(unit.tree):
            if isinstance(imp,(ast.Import,ast.ImportFrom)):
                for alias in imp.names:
                    if any(name==alias.name or name.startswith(alias.name+'.') or
                           (isinstance(imp,ast.ImportFrom) and name==f'{imp.module}.{alias.name}')
                           for name in names):
                        origin.append({'line':imp.lineno,'source':ast.get_source_segment(unit.source,imp)})
        record={**unit.point(node),'module':module or None,'direct_call':direct_call,
                'targets':names,'import_facts':origin,'python_qualnames':codes[node.lineno],
                'argument_ast_kinds':([type(a).__name__ for a in node.body.args]+
                                      [type(k.value).__name__ for k in node.body.keywords]) if direct_call else []}
        rows.append(record)
        if direct_call and len(names)==1 and origin and len(set(codes[node.lineno]))==1:
            name=codes[node.lineno][0]
            record['specified_id']=path+'#PROXY#'+name
            groups[record['specified_id']].append(record)
collisions=[{'specified_id':key,'callables':value} for key,value in sorted(groups.items()) if len(value)>1]
value={'head':manifest['head'],'tree':manifest['tree'],'rules_sha256':manifest['rules_sha256'],
       'scope':'Anonymous-callable lexical-ID feasibility only; NOT candidate universe, E9-5, or OBS',
       'python_entries':sum(e['entry_kind']=='PY_SOURCE' for e in manifest['entries']),
       'non_python_text_entries':sum(e['entry_kind'] in {'DOC','OTHER_TEXT','BUILD','PACKAGING','CI_CONFIG','IMPORT_LINTER','PTH','SHELL'} for e in manifest['entries']),
       'context_counts':dict(Counter(e['context'] for e in manifest['entries'])),
       'lambda_sites':rows,'collision_groups':collisions}
target=out/'anonymous-callable-id.json'
assert not target.exists()
write_atomic(target,value)
print('python_entries=',value['python_entries'],'non_python_text_entries=',value['non_python_text_entries'])
print('contexts=',value['context_counts'])
print('lambda_sites=',len(rows),'direct_import_call_id_collision_groups=',len(collisions))
for collision in collisions:
    print(json.dumps(collision,ensure_ascii=False))
print('output_sha256=',hashlib.sha256(target.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
print('NO_OBS / NO_ADMISSION / NO_E9_5_COMPLETENESS_CLAIM')
